# Hallon

Affiliation: Hildir | Place of birth: Plains | Species: Lox | Gender: Unknown | Eye color: Yellow

# Introduction

Hallon is a character found in Meadows. It is a tamed Lox that accompanies Hildir at her trading camp.

## Biography

Nothing is known about Hallon beyond the fact it is a Lox that resides with Hildir in her camp feeding from a bowl alongside Blåbär.

## Trivia

• "Hallon" is swedish word, meaning raspberry. It is derived from hall "cliff" and -on (suffix for fruits and berries).
• Hallon and Blåbär can be pet.
